g.title: cluster_data
g.text: On disk · built once by the first pass, reused

g.title: PRE
g.text: splits unedited · labels held to NAVSIM
live ViT output = the cache · projection

g.title: OPT
g.text: cosine to 0 per step · no warmup

g.title: STP
g.text: every 50 steps: loss terms per layer, lr,
gradient norm, AMP scale, data wait

g.title: MET
g.text: every epoch: train means + select readout

g.title: SUM
g.text: kept epoch = best select F1 within 30 m

g.title: REP
g.text: at the kept and the last epoch
